answer_1.quote: The feedback generation task aims to generate targeted feedback based on the content of the essay... The BART decoder acts as the feedback generator...

answer_2.quote: We use BERTScore to measure the similarity between the generated feedback and the rubric text... We also report BLEU scores and ROUGE values between the model-generated feedback and the reference feedback on the test set.
